name: liquid-glass

frames.best_why: Frame 5 centres the frosted card with its edge glow visible and the cursor clear of the text.

tagline: A frosted pane floats on a purple gradient and blurs what is behind it.
summary: A translucent rounded card sits on a coloured background and blurs whatever shows through it, with bright inner edges and a soft outer halo. It can be picked up and dragged, and it lifts a little on hover.
appearance: A rounded frosted rectangle, about a sixth of the frame, resting on an indigo-to-pink gradient. White text reads a big temperature, a condition and a city, with a faint hint line below. Its edges catch a thin white highlight and a soft glow spreads outside.
behaviour: The pane can be grabbed and dragged; letting go lets it spring back with a slight bounce. Hovering enlarges it a fraction and pressing shrinks it briefly. Content inside stays sharp while the area behind is blurred.
demo_content: A weather readout: 24°C, Partly Cloudy, San Francisco, CA, and the hint Drag me · Hover to glow.
search_phrases: frosted glass card on a gradient
use_when: You want a translucent panel that keeps a vivid background visible behind the content it holds.
avoid_when: Backdrop blur and the SVG distortion are costly on weak devices, and glass needs a colourful backdrop to read.
customise: Blur, shadow, glow and radius each take a named size or value prop, plus draggable and expandable toggles and width props. The inner content is whatever children you pass.
weight_why: Backdrop blur plus an SVG displacement filter run over a draggable animated node.

a11y.note: Drag is pointer-only with no keyboard path, and nothing announces the card's purpose to screen readers.

issues: The bottom hint line at 60% white is barely readable against the bright gradient.
polish_why: Layered glass edges and a believable glow; the inner hint text is very faint.
